scope: Public documentation and fixed source acquisition candidates only; no build, GUI, model, learning or scoring runs

selected_candidates.name: To-Day

build_evidence.official_readme: SwiftUI macOS 13+ menu-bar checklist; local add/edit/move/complete, title/date sorting and completed visibility.
build_evidence.fixed_source: Today.xcodeproj declares deployment targets 13.0 and 13.1; source uses a Sparkle package version range beginning at 2.0.0. README documents archive/notarization/update distribution, not a complete reproducible build command.
build_evidence.runtime_expected: Local checklist core needs no account; Sparkle updater/network features are excluded from proposed tasks. No timer is claimed.
limitations: Xcode/Swift packages and bundle signing remain unverified.
README acknowledges missing VoiceOver menu text; AX and coordinate interaction must be admitted on a real macOS host.
Todo state persistence, reset and backend storage must be observed before any task is frozen.

sequence: Observe three synthetic todo items in the menu and editor, including add/edit/move and completion transitions.
Independently recreate the observed menu/editor state machine without reading implementation or any benchmark tests.
Selfcheck item text, ordering and complete/incomplete state after reopening.
validator_expected: Controlled item set and exact ordering
Completed state persists and can be reversed
workflows.evidence: Pinned README lines 3-9; future reference observation required.

sequence: Observe sorting by title versus creation time and the display/hide/delete completed settings.
Recreate the menu changes from controlled item fixtures.
Verify expected list membership and order across settings changes and confirmation cancellation.
validator_expected: Deletion affects only the intended completed items
workflows.evidence: Pinned README sorting and visibility features; not an existing official validator.

skill_expectation: Inspect menu-bar UI and editor as coupled views of persistent state
Disentangle filtering, sorting and destructive state changes
Use local fixtures and reopen checks

bench_correspondence.capability: Task CRUD/completion and ordering, not the complete GTD backend
List form state only, not project scheduling

source_isolation.manual_evidence: README presents an independently authored SwiftUI checklist; Sparkle is an updater dependency, not the product family.
source_isolation.family_risk: Full dependency and code-similarity isolation are not proven by repository identity checks.

selected_candidates.name: OpenCalc

build_evidence.official_readme: Android calculator with scientific mode, history, portrait/landscape and quick-settings entry. README lists Android 5+.
build_evidence.fixed_source: app/build.gradle.kts declares compile/target SDK 35 and min SDK 21. Java/Kotlin targets 1.8. The v3.2.1 source tag declares versionName 3.2.0, a retained release-label discrepancy. No claimed official CLI build recipe; Android Gradle project import is a source-side build inference.
build_evidence.runtime_expected: Offline arithmetic uses local inputs and no application account. Manifest/merged-permission and scientific-mode semantics still require admission.
limitations: SDK 35, Gradle plugins and Android dependencies are not built or locked here.
No unit conversion capability is claimed; CalcYou unit-converter behavior remains unknown.
UiAutomator selectors, numeric precision, invalid expressions, DEG/RAD semantics and history persistence must be observed.

sequence: Observe controlled arithmetic expressions, precedence, backspace/clear and result/history transitions.
Independently implement the observed numeric UI behavior with an explicit state model.
Selfcheck exact known inputs, result display, invalid-input handling and replayed history.
workflows.evidence: Pinned README scientific/history features; exact parser behavior requires public UI observation.

sequence: Observe portrait/landscape and scientific panel state, using only controls actually present in the fixed app.
Independently recreate panel switching and a small set of observed scientific functions.
Check that switching views does not silently reset the expression and that controlled numeric results agree.
workflows.evidence: Pinned README orientation/scientific features; DEG/RAD is conditional on observed controls.

skill_expectation: Probe input-output contracts separately from button appearance
Maintain expression, edit and history states coherently
Use controlled numeric oracles and edge cases

bench_correspondence.capability: Scientific calculator expression/result interaction; graphing remains unknown
Calculator input/output; unit conversion remains unknown

source_isolation.manual_evidence: Canonical owner redirect treated as an alias. Current source is not identified as an Arity/CalcYou product fork; common Android libraries do not establish family independence.
source_isolation.family_risk: Parser/dependency and code-copy provenance must be reviewed before strict family-isolated evaluation.

selected_candidates.download_size: Official README's approximately 2 MB APK is a product description, not the actual downloaded source size. Use root acquisition manifest.

selected_candidates.name: Shattered Pixel Dungeon

build_evidence.official_readme: Roguelike with randomized levels/items; official source supports Android and desktop.
build_evidence.fixed_source: Pinned desktop guide explicitly documents ./gradlew desktop:debug and ./gradlew desktop:release. Android guide documents Android Studio import/build. Root Gradle uses AGP 9.2.0, SDK 36 compile/target, min SDK 21, Java source compatibility 11 and LibGDX 1.14.0; actual Gradle runtime JDK compatibility must be resolved from pinned toolchain.
build_evidence.runtime_expected: Local game/menu core needs no account; platform stores, news and update links excluded. macOS desktop JAR/app is possible per official guide, but is not an AppKit-native AX claim.
limitations: AGP 9.2/Gradle/JDK/SDK 36 and native LibGDX dependencies remain a build risk.
Randomized levels require reset/replay admission; no deterministic gameplay, complete-game success or RNG-control patch is assumed.
Canvas AX/UiAutomator tree may be sparse; screenshots/coordinates and macOS graphics availability need runtime checks.
No audio transport, countdown timer, scientific plotting, Minesweeper or Go-rule fidelity is inferred from this game.

sequence: Observe opening menu, new-game/class selection and bounded help/settings overlays on a reset reference.
Independently recreate these menu and overlay transitions without copying source.
Verify selected state, back/cancel paths and restored screen after closing overlays.
workflows.evidence: Official game purpose/platform docs; particular controls must first be publicly observed.

sequence: Observe a short local turn sequence and visible inventory/item/use states, avoiding a full campaign objective.
Build an independent bounded recreation of the observed rule/state transitions.
Replay the observed initial state and compare movement, inventory and visible counters; distinguish seed-dependent outcomes.
workflows.evidence: Pinned README documents roguelike levels/items; precise mechanics and replay contract remain future observation work.

skill_expectation: Discover rules through controlled action/observation pairs
Represent game state separately from canvas rendering
Validate deterministic parts and disclose stochastic outcomes

bench_correspondence.capability: RPG menu/inventory/progression state, not identical game mechanics
Bounded game-rule probes and reset behavior, not puzzle rules
Desktop game board/action/state separation, not Go rules

source_isolation.manual_evidence: Pinned README explicitly derives from Pixel Dungeon. Both upstream identities are included in the full native/web audit.
source_isolation.family_risk: Derivative game family is known and retained; no exact matching benchmark identity is insufficient to rule out copied dependencies/assets.

selected_candidates.download_size: Root acquisition manifest records actual source bytes; no size estimate is substituted for an acquired archive.

selected_candidates.name: Package Manager

build_evidence.official_readme: System/user app listing and details include package name, paths, granted/denied permissions, activities, dates, certificates and manifests. Root access is required only for some advanced features.
build_evidence.fixed_source: v7.0 app Gradle uses compile/target SDK 33, min SDK 23, build tools 30.0.3; root AGP 7.3.1 with Maven/JitPack dependencies. F-Droid flavor exists and avoids the Play billing dependency. README does not provide a complete CLI recipe; Gradle flavor build is a source-side inference.
build_evidence.runtime_expected: Use read-only listing/detail workflows on an isolated emulator with controlled installed fixtures. No root, adb privilege escalation, uninstall, install, enable/disable or debloating task is authorized.
limitations: v7.9 initial candidate rejected for SDK 37 and retained independently; v7.0 replaces it without editing a frozen experiment.
Old AGP/JDK/Gradle compatibility and JitPack availability remain unverified.
Manifest requests package-query/install/delete/superuser permissions; tasks and harness must stay within read-only app/permission inspection.
Package visibility and OS version alter reported details; fixtures and expected values require admission.

sequence: Observe user/system/all list filters and a controlled fixture's detail page.
Independently recreate list/filter/navigation state using synthetic package metadata.
Check list membership, package identity and back navigation against the controlled fixture.
validator_expected: Detail identity agrees with selected item
Read-only navigation does not mutate installed applications
workflows.evidence: Pinned README lines 25-35; exact controls must be publicly observed.

sequence: Observe granted/denied permission and manifest/activity panels for a synthetic fixture app.
Independently implement the observed detail views with an explicit permission state model.
Verify displayed permission classification and stability across view switching, without granting or revoking permissions.
validator_expected: No mutation of app installation or permission state
workflows.evidence: Pinned README permission/manifest features; no official evaluator is inspected.

Separate permission declaration from grant state
Use deterministic local fixtures and avoid accidental system changes

bench_correspondence.capability: Permission/system-state reasoning only; live privacy indicators remain unknown
System-derived state distinction only; quick-tile operations remain unknown
